popup.busCrowdingSim.note: Among weekday trips leaving the segment's first stop between 7 and 9 am, the share whose load reaches capacity (assumed 65 passengers). The two values assume 7–9 am accounts for 13.7% and 18.0% of daily ridership. Simulated estimate, not measured.
popup.busCrowdingSim.source: TDX bus routes and timetables; taipei-gis-analytics bus crowding model (estimate)
popup.busCrowdingSim.vehicleGone: This trip is outside the simulated window
popup.busCrowdingSim.vehicleNote: On-board load is the estimated load after leaving a stop as a share of vehicle capacity (an assumed value), shown in bands; the two values assume 13.7% and 18.0% of daily ridership falls in 7–9 a.m. Simulated estimate, not measured.
